title: timesheet.submitted.v1
description: Timesheet. Published when it is submitted for approval inside finance. `owner` is the subject whose timesheet it is. Delivered at least once; consumers de-duplicate on `id`. Carries identifiers, dates and counts only: no names, amounts, reasons or other text (fetch the record through the capability if the token allows).

id.description: Unique event id, stable across redeliveries.
